title: cMini: Continuum's own Pokémon Mini emulator
default: PokeMini remains first and default; cMini is second.

items.title: Settings inventory
items.result: PMINI_OPTIONS_INVENTORY.md records PokeMini's 13 settings and cMini's two hardware-backed additions.

items.title: MINX and machine
items.result: Standalone Rust crate with cycle-accounted MINX, memory map, interrupts, timers, PRC, direct LCD, PWM/piezo audio, EEPROM, controls, shock, rumble and infrared.

items.title: Libretro behavior
items.result: Video, audio, input, options, 8192-byte PokeMini-compatible save RAM, tagged states, achievements memory and real/direct BIOS starts.

items.title: Reference proof
items.result: MAME 0.289 and cMini ran the original stand-in and reached the same RAM marker; the reference runner also checked register, timer, PRC, frame, audio, EEPROM and replay evidence. Scratch frontend runs opened the stand-in on cMini and PokeMini.

items.title: App and build integration
items.result: Optional unpinned Cargo core, cache checker coverage, Xcode embed, CI-name exemption, CoreCatalog descriptor and second Pokémon Mini choice.

items.title: Phone proof
items.result: Needs the later single batch iPhone build with cAtari; PokeMini stays default meanwhile.

limitations: No iOS SDK is available locally; phone behavior is not marked Done.
Commercial games and a commercial bios.min were not obtained or used.
